userDefinedCodeListEntries.entryDescription: A command transitioned lifecycle state (data: Command).
A device changed state (data: DeviceStatus).
An alert was raised (data: Alert).
An alert changed lifecycle state (data: Alert).
A reservation reached its no-show condition (data: AssignedRight reference + reservation state).
A toll transaction was created (data: TollTransaction).
A toll transaction changed status, including disputes (data: TollTransaction).
A subscription exhausted its retry schedule and was marked failed (data: subscription reference).
Occupancy changed materially for a place element — threshold crossing or publisher-defined delta (data: OccupancySnapshot).
A payment was recorded — taken via /v1/payments or ingested from a lane device (data: PaymentRecord). Fills the financial-analytics gap: APDS EventTypeEnum has no payment events.
A new Observation was ingested — LPR read, RFID hit, sensor event (data: the APDS Observation; subject references it). Fills the sensor-analytics gap: APDS EventTypeEnum has no Observation events.
A resolution context was created or materially recomputed (data: ResolutionContext) — enables event-driven preloading so agent consoles pop before the call is answered.
A support interaction was recorded or updated (data: SupportInteraction).
A violation candidate was recorded from automated, guided, or manual detection (data: Violation) — drives guided-enforcement handheld queues.
A notice, warning, or citation was issued on a violation (data: Violation).
A violation changed lifecycle state — review, payment, appeal open/resolve, void (data: Violation).
A validation was applied to a ticket/session from any channel, or reversed (data: ValidationRedemption).
A validation program was enrolled, suspended, resumed, or ended (data: ValidationProgram).
A merchant billing period was closed into an immutable statement (data: ValidationStatement).
A credential was issued, activated, suspended, resumed, reported lost, revoked, expired, or replaced (data: CredentialRecord).
A credential was presented at a lane and access was granted or denied (data: CredentialAccessEvent). Fills the gap: APDS EventTypeEnum has no access events.
A valet ticket changed lifecycle state — dropped, parked, retrieving, staged, handed back, closed, cancelled (data: ValetTicket).
A customer or attendant requested a valeted vehicle; carries channel, ETA, and promised time (data: ValetTicket) — drives runner boards and customer notifications.
